_description: Curated question/expected pairs used by eval_runner.py to detect regressions in the agent (routing, tool use, memory, answer quality). Replace the example schema below with your own items. Update this file whenever prompts, tools, or routing change (see CLAUDE.md workflow rules).

_schema.query: exact user input to send to the agent
_schema.expected_tools: tools the agent should (or should not) call
_schema.expected_keywords: substrings that must appear in the answer
_schema.min_score: minimum judge score required to pass
